committee.sub: Morning brief · Sunday 13 September 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend held flat at $115.57 versus $114.72 prior, and clicks matched at 19 versus 19, with CTR up to 5.5% from 3%, yet conversions are still zero. Post restart clicks since 8 Sept sit at 17, nowhere near the 150 stop-loss trigger.

Search Console data only runs through 10 Sept, two days behind yesterday (Sat 12), so treat it as a lagging read. Impressions were 252 over 8 days against just 3 clicks, with target terms parked at position 39 to 50 while the brand term 'kontrol' sits at 7. Budget lost 30d is 16.6% against rank lost 30d at 77%, so the budget conversation stays closed for now.

Landing sessions are led by /ai-automation-agency.html on 16 and the homepage on 15, but the Search Console top page, /simpro-xero-integration.html, drew 148 impressions and zero clicks at position 20, pointing to a message match gap between what people search and what that page delivers.

Organic Search ticked up to 8 sessions from 3, still the only unpaid signal worth trusting given it is genuinely tiny. AI Assistant sessions stayed at 0 for both periods, nothing to report there yet. Direct fell from 32 to 11, but that drop lines up with the internal traffic filter cutting out Chris's own visits rather than any real change in unpaid demand.

actions.text: Logo and image assets plus keyword-matched RSA headlines for the currently serving ad groups are still outstanding, get these finalised.
The homepage form still needs the confirm-then-count fix so kontrolTrackLead fires on the Formspree verdict rather than before it.
RSA description D1 still claims 13.3 hours of admin per week, update the copy to match the current site stats.
